title: A Meta-Evaluation of Faithfulness Metrics for Long-Form Hospital-Course Summarization
reasoning: The paper uses the term 'faithfulness' to refer to the factual consistency and accuracy of generated summaries with respect to source documents, which is a technical aspect of natural language generation evaluation. It does not deal with religious faith, spiritual traditions, morals, or ethics in a broader philosophical or societal sense. The title and content relate solely to assessing the factual correctness of generated text in a clinical context.
